dex.m: An order or factor of ten.

dexes.m: More than one dex. dex: an order or factor of ten.

dextran.m: A biopolymer of glucose produced by enzymes of certain bacteria.

dextranase.m: An enzyme that catalyzes the endohydrolysis of (1->6)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in dextran.

dextranases.m: More than one dextranase. dextranase: an enzyme that catalyzes the endohydrolysis of (1->6)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in dextran.

dextrans.m: More than one dextran. dextran: a biopolymer of glucose produced by enzymes of certain bacteria.

dextrine.m: Another spelling of dextrin. dextrin: any of various polysaccharides obtained by hydrolysis of starch; a tasteless and odourless gummy substance that is used as a thickening agent and in adhesives and in dietary supplements.

dextro.m: Another spelling of dextrorotatory. dextrorotatory: rotating to the right.
